challenges.name: 4 pushes 0--0--0
challenges.creator: Sporran
challenges.description: Four-push training sequence against a generic defensive front line. Recordings demonstrate mechanics; dice and rules legality have not been independently verified.
challenges.coachNotes: This is a demonstration of the chain-push mechanics. The initial opposing players do not represent a verified race-specific defensive formation.
challenges.probabilityContext: No dice probabilities have been calculated for this demonstration.

defences.name: Generic three-player line of scrimmage
defences.creator: Sporran
defences.description: Three defending linemen on the line of scrimmage. An introductory formation for learning how pushes work; not ranked as effective defence.
defences.notes: The demonstration has no verified defensive race, skills or tactical effectiveness. Coaches can replace the opposing players or add a full defensive team in Free Play.

plannedAlternatives.name: Early knockdown — investigate a different route
plannedAlternatives.trigger: A relevant early block knocks the target down rather than leaving a standing player available for subsequent repositioning.
plannedAlternatives.description: Investigate a legal alternative when the intended chain-push arrangement cannot continue after a knockdown. This may require a different scorer or different blocking route, or may have no viable continuation.

plannedAlternatives.name: Extra forward push — reduce Rush requirements
plannedAlternatives.trigger: The coach can arrange one additional legal forward chain push.
plannedAlternatives.description: Explore whether an additional push can reduce the required Rush rolls for the intended scorer. The current recording does not demonstrate this route and its feasibility is unverified.

plannedAlternatives.name: Side Step defender — adapt the chain push
plannedAlternatives.trigger: A defender with Side Step chooses a square that interrupts the expected push route.
plannedAlternatives.description: Construct and record a solution, if one exists, against an appropriate Side Step defender. This is a different hypothetical matchup, not an alternative already demonstrated in the original recording.
